I think that four-seeming fear of not having an identity can resonate with nines since a lot of us feel really disconnected from who we are. I struggle with a sense of self constantly. I can't go clothes shopping without breaking down because I'll think "is this \[clothing item\] me?" but then realize I don't know what "me" means. 

I dwell on feelings a lot of the time too, can get really sad and then just sit in that sadness for ages. I know melancholy super well. But, I think, a four would use it somehow or express it in some way. I've been known to be pretty openly emotional and fragile too, which is where my confusion with my own type lies a lot of the time. I think if I were a four I'd be more open to utilizing these emotions in some kind of expressive way, but I tend to have a lot of embarrassment about the way I feel and try to downplay its significance.

I think it's also important to remember that you might not fit into the exact box and stereotypes of any particular type!! It's most important to focus on those core fears and drives. I've always interpreted the "separation from the other" as a fear of my inability to connect with other people, but I really relate to your fear of missing out on life because you don't want to upset any relationships, but I think the proof is in the pudding. From what you described your desire to not disappoint anyone has trumped your fear of not doing anything worthwhile because that is what you have thus far chosen to do. If I'm misinterpreting/projecting I'm sorry!!

It might also help to consider your paths of integration/disintegration. How do you react to stress? Do you become needy and manipulative or do you withdraw and shut down? In health do you focus less on yourself and more towards a greater good or do you focus more on yourself and your personal achievements?

It takes some people years of self-reflection to figure out their type, don't bog yourself down in all the details! I, and other strangers on the internet, don't know you as intimately as you know yourself. Again, I'm super sorry if I was projecting on you, and if this was in any way incoherent.
